claims.claim: People already entitled to the full new State Pension cannot pay (or are excluded from paying) voluntary contributions.
claims.quote: Each qualifying year after 6 April 2016 added to your National Insurance record increases your State Pension amount, up to the full rate ( £241.30 a week).
claims.note: The text implies extra years add nothing beyond the full rate, but the stated bar on paying is having no gaps in your record, not being entitled to the full State Pension.

claims.claim: You need 35 qualifying years to get the full new State Pension.
claims.quote: If your National Insurance record started after April 2016 you will need 35 qualifying years to get the full rate of new State Pension.
claims.note: The text gives 35 years only for records starting after April 2016 and says people who were contracted out usually need more than 35.
